newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IOC buys 30,000/T Apr 19-23 fuel oil from Glencore.
newsitem.headline: IOC buys 30,000/T Apr 19-23 fuel oil from Glencore.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has bought 30,000 tonnes of 3.5-percent sulphur fuel oil for delivery April 19-23 to Bombay from Swiss-based trader Glencore, industry sources said on Wednesday.
IOC awarded the 180-cst grade cargo at $7.90 per tonne above spot Middle East quotes on a free-on-board (fob) Fujairah basis, the sources said.
In its last fuel oil purchase, IOC bought 30,000 tonnes of 3.5-percent, 180-cst grade at $13.90 per tonne above Middle East quotes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis for April 10-14 delivery.
